perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.desc: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Jolting Feedback
perks.desc:
Dealing repeated damage with this weapon inflicts Jolt. 

While amplified, Jolt is applied faster.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Gear Shift
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow or becoming amplified grants a period of increased damage. Stacks 5x.

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Bray Legacy
perks.desc: Damage with this weapon generates a small amount of ability energy for the one closest to a full charge.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 120 from 29 October 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3tLWOteO62mxx6Yh2Ll4k3?si=bb40d9918c564281) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add clearing minor enemies in general and end-game, underleveled content, particularly with an Arc build. VS Pyroelectric Propellant is funky-looking arc adaptive auto-rifle with very decent stats. At base, 42 Range equates to 25.60m while ADS, 60 Handling is 0.35s ready, 0.28s ADS speed and 0.32s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 50 is a 1.81s reload. To be honest, you'll be good with pretty much any barrel and magazine perk combination (except maybe Full Bore) - play into your own preferences. If you are looking towards the new-to-season-25 Jolting Feedback trait perk in the second column though, larger magazines work well - you might be able to apply Jolt to three targets before you need to reload. For arc builds, you can pair this with Eddy Current in the first column for gunfeel boosts while Amplified. Jolting Feedback is a great end-game trait perk, applying Jolt on the 16th bullet (12 when Amplified) - and one fewer (15 and 11) when Enhanced - and not requiring a kill to proc. Maybe pair with Sparks of Amplitude, Ions and Discharge or Facets of Awakening and Purpose to synergise with arc builds. The Bray Legacy origin trait is useful in PvE, working in the background to add ability energy to the one closest to a full charge on every tick of weapon damage. Recommended MW: your choice depending on your preference, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, a Synergy mod for additional Ionic Traces for more frequent Amplification, or Stunloader when there's a matching artifact mod.
